title: THE WAITING OF LAST MEETING
summary: Chapter 5 — The Little Things That Became Beautiful Memories
body:
**Chapter 5 — The Little Things That Became Beautiful Memories**

As time passed, our relationship continued to grow in its own beautiful way. Our conversations became longer, and sometimes we would talk for an hour or even more. We started sharing almost everything with each other. Sometimes we talked about our daily lives, sometimes we joked, and sometimes we had little arguments. But even those small disagreements became part of our everyday connection. Without realising it, we had started becoming an important part of each other's lives.

I still remember one particular conversation when I told her that I was craving pulao. It was just a normal conversation, and I never expected anything special to happen because of it. But she remembered what I had said. After asking her aunt, she prepared pulao as a surprise for me. Later, she called me over and gave it to me. The pulao was delicious, and I enjoyed every bite of it. More than the food, what touched me was the thought behind that little surprise. Nobody had ever surprised me like that before. It was a small gesture, but it became one of those memories that stayed with me.

After that, there were many little moments that made me feel special. Whenever she prepared something good, she would sometimes call me over and share it with me. I also tried to give something back whenever I could. But somehow, I always felt that she gave me more through her little gestures than I could ever express in return. It was never about who gave more or who did more. It was about the happiness of remembering someone and doing something for them without needing a special reason.

There were also moments of laughter, jokes and occasional anger between us. One thing I always understood about her was that she valued honesty very much. She did not like lies, and I knew how important the truth was to her. Because of that, I always tried to be honest with her. I wanted to be loyal to her, not just through my words but through my actions as well. I believed that trust and honesty were important parts of what we were building together.

I also remember one ordinary day when I went to her house for some work. She was washing clothes and having difficulty squeezing the water out of them. She asked me to help her, so I started helping her with the clothes. It was such a simple household moment, nothing extraordinary. But she recorded a video of that moment on her phone. She said she would keep it and show it to her mother when she went home. I remember enjoying that moment. Sometimes, the happiest memories are not created during special occasions; they happen in the middle of ordinary days, when we are simply spending time together.

As our closeness increased, I noticed another change in my daily routine. Earlier, I used to spend a lot of time talking with my family. But gradually, my conversations with them became less frequent because I was spending more and more time talking to her. I would talk to her in the morning, in the evening and sometimes late at night. Our calls became a regular part of my day. Eventually, I realised that I was giving less time to my family, and that feeling started bothering me.

When I shared this feeling with her, her response was something I could never forget. She told me, "I have never stopped you from talking to your family. Whenever you feel like talking to them, whether in the morning, evening or late at night, you can always talk to them. I have never asked you to give them less time. You should spend as much time with them as you want. I am always here for you, and I will always support you." Her words touched me deeply. She never wanted me to distance myself from my family just because we were spending more time together. Instead, she reminded me of the importance of keeping my family close. At that moment, my respect for her grew even more.

After that conversation, I tried to give time to both my family and her. I continued talking to my family while also maintaining the beautiful connection we had developed. Life was moving forward, and our conversations continued. Another month or two passed in the same way. We shared our daily experiences, laughed together, talked about little things and slowly created more memories. Everything seemed to be going well. I never imagined that an ordinary day could suddenly become one of the most unforgettable nights of my life.

Then, one night, something unexpected happened. I was working my night shift, as usual, when my phone suddenly caught my attention. When I looked at the screen, I noticed that she had called me again and again. There were around fifteen missed calls from her. I was surprised because receiving so many calls from her at once was unusual. I wondered what could have happened and why she was trying so desperately to reach me. Something felt different that night. I knew there had to be a reason behind those calls, but I had no idea what it was.

**Fifteen missed calls. One unexpected night. And a moment that would change the direction of our story. But what had happened that night? Why was she calling me so many times? And what was the reason behind those calls that I would never forget?**
